css: .ui-root .loot-prompt, .ui-root .loot-notice { position: absolute; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); max-width: min(70vw, 570px); padding: 8px 14px; text-align: center; border: 1px solid rgba(232,194,122,.5); border-radius: 8px; color: #fff0d3; background: rgba(20,10,24,.9); } .ui-root .loot-prompt { bottom: max(30px, calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 22px)); pointer-events: auto; } .ui-root .loot-notice { bottom: max(82px, calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 74px)); pointer-events: none; } .ui-root:not([data-ui-top="hud"]) :is(.loot-prompt,.loot-notice) { display: none; }
